ideas.title: Investigating the Impact of Medicaid Funding Freeze on Minnesota Healthcare Services
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential consequences of the Trump administration's decision to freeze Medicaid funding in Minnesota.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and interviews with healthcare professionals
questions: What are the potential consequences of the Medicaid funding freeze on Minnesota healthcare services?
How will this decision impact vulnerable populations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant implications for healthcare services in Minnesota. By analyzing data and conducting interviews with healthcare professionals, we can shed light on the potential consequences of this decision.

ideas.title: Uncovering Corruption within the LAUSD Administration
ideas.description: This story would investigate the alleged misuse of funds by LAUSD Superintendent Alberto Carvalho and potential corruption within the LAUSD administration.
ideas.angle: Investigative reporting and interviews with sources
questions: What is the extent of the alleged misuse of funds by Carvalho?
Are there other instances of corruption within the LAUSD administration?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant corruption within the LAUSD administration. By conducting investigative reporting and analyzing data, we can shed light on the alleged misuse of funds and potential corruption.
